route: El Puerto de Santa María - Jerez de la Frontera
story: Callum Thornley set an early strong time, only beaten by Stefan Küng. Top time-trial specialists Hayter, Van Aert, and Almeida underperformed. As expected, Primož Roglič gained time on Enric Mas, who retains a 1:37 lead heading into the final three stages.
